descriptor: Bite-sized habit app with scratch-off deals

voice.summary: Pip talks like an excitable friend handing you a lottery ticket: bright, chatty and always a bit pleased. Prices and discounts stay plain, so the fun never hides the number.
dos: Treat the discount as a small surprise
State the price and the saving in numbers
Keep copy punchy with short verbs

taglines: A little luck, a lot of savings
Grow your habit, keep your change
Reveal the code, watch it drop
boilerplate: Pip is a habit-building app made of bite-sized daily actions, offered in three plans from Seed to Grove, with occasional scratch-off coupons for new users.

microcopy.error: That code is not valid. Try scratching again.
microcopy.empty: No coupon yet. Scratch the card.

logo.note: A spark suggests a small idea catching, the way a habit starts.
